Team —

Thanks for the quick interviews yesterday. We need final scores and the short justifications so we can lock a decision for this role by the end of week. Current status: two interviewers in and one outstanding (Laura, I know you flagged a calendar conflict).

Ask: please submit your completed scorecard to the shared sheet (link below) and reply with any blocking concerns by EOD Tuesday, Jan 20 17:00 PST. If we have a numeric tie after aggregation, here's the tie-resolution rule I propose:

- Step 1: Compare aggregate score (sum of rubric categories).
- Step 2: If tied, we use the median of individual overall recommendations.
- Step 3: If still tied, the hiring manager (me) will make the final call after a 30-min sync or quick review of red flags.

Please also attach any annotated notes (one-pager preferred) — that helps with calibration for the hiring committee. I've attached the blank candidate_scorecard template in case anyone prefers to use it offline.

Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcdEFgHIjKlmnopQrsTuvWX/edit#gid=0
